title: Enterprise Procurement Evidence Pack Design v1 — Rig Relay
purpose: Design for a self-service evidence pack that Rig Relay can generate automatically to support enterprise procurement, security review, and compliance assessment.

pack_artifacts.description: Content-light security architecture summary: trust boundaries, assets, threat count, mitigation status, release gate status.
pack_artifacts.content_light_constraints: No raw secrets, tokens, source code, file paths, or attack details.

pack_artifacts.description: Complete data class inventory with sensitivity classifications, storage locations, retention periods, and protection mechanisms.
pack_artifacts.content_light_constraints: Inventory metadata only. No actual data samples.

pack_artifacts.description: Four-category telemetry and evidence disclosure: (1) product telemetry — first-party, default-on, opt-out, content-light, degrades adaptive/product-learning behavior when disabled; (2) remote telemetry contribution — settings-controlled, default-off, consent-gated; (3) local operational observability — mandatory for governed operation, not subject to product-telemetry opt-out; (4) enterprise audit/evidence — mandatory in enterprise mode, continues when product telemetry is disabled. Includes degraded-behavior matrix, content-light and forbidden-content guarantees, and aggregate/de-identified/derived commercialization boundary.
pack_artifacts.content_light_constraints: Event names, counts, metadata only. No raw event payloads.

pack_artifacts.description: Tool permission model, bash safety controls, environment scrubbing, binary rejection, rerouting rules, mutation gates.
pack_artifacts.content_light_constraints: Policy descriptions only. No tool call examples with real data.

pack_artifacts.description: JSON/JSONL/CSV source-of-truth model: how evidence is structured, append-only guarantees, Merkle receipts, replay/verification.
pack_artifacts.content_light_constraints: Schema descriptions and replay flow. No raw evidence.

pack_artifacts.description: Postgres deployment model, schema ownership, migration strategy, RLS, backup/restore, encryption, admin queries.
pack_artifacts.content_light_constraints: Architecture and policy only. No connection strings or credentials.

pack_artifacts.description: Summary SBOM: dependency count, license distribution, known vulnerability count, last scan date, criticality assessment.
pack_artifacts.content_light_constraints: Summary statistics. Full SBOM available as SPDX JSON alongside.

pack_artifacts.description: Vulnerability scanning status, known vulnerabilities, remediation status, patching SLA, disclosure process.
pack_artifacts.content_light_constraints: CVE IDs, severity, status. No exploit details.

pack_artifacts.description: SLSA level, build attestation status, artifact signing, checksums, release frequency, supported platforms.
pack_artifacts.content_light_constraints: Provenance metadata only. No build secrets.

pack_artifacts.description: Test count by classification (unit/contract/integration/e2e/adversarial/etc.), coverage assessment, CI status.
pack_artifacts.content_light_constraints: Counts and classifications only. No test source code.

pack_artifacts.description: Honest disclosure of known limitations: alpha status, single-maintainer, prompt injection gaps, no SSO, etc.
Open risks from threat model, supply-chain audit, and enterprise readiness audit.
pack_artifacts.content_light_constraints: Risk descriptions and mitigations. No exploit details.

pack_artifacts.description: Privacy controls: redaction validator, content-light guarantee, consent model, data retention, deletion procedures.
Admin deployment guide: install channels, configuration, health checks, diagnostics, backup, upgrade procedures.
pack_artifacts.content_light_constraints: Operational guidance only. No secrets or internal infrastructure details.

pack_artifacts.description: Incident classification, response process, communication plan, post-incident review.
Support model, debug packet creation/quarantine, redaction guarantees, support SLA (if applicable).
pack_artifacts.content_light_constraints: Policy only. No example debug data.

pack_artifacts.description: Explicit boundary model: product telemetry (default-on, opt-out, degrades adaptive behavior when disabled), remote telemetry contribution (settings-controlled, default-off), local operational observability (mandatory for governed operation), enterprise audit/evidence (mandatory in enterprise mode). Procurement-facing disclosure of all four categories with control surfaces and continuity guarantees.
pack_artifacts.content_light_constraints: Category definitions, control surfaces, opt-out behavior. No raw telemetry payloads.

pack_artifacts.description: Exhaustive matrix: which behaviors degrade when product telemetry is disabled (adaptive recommendations, UX optimization, agent-tool optimization, Ralph refinement, orchestrator behavior, subagent behavior) and which behaviors must continue (governance, receipts, release gates, mutation receipts, schema validation records, export manifests, enterprise audit events, local operational observability).
pack_artifacts.content_light_constraints: Behavior names and degradation status only. No telemetry payloads.

pack_artifacts.description: Guarantee that enterprise audit/evidence records (receipts, release gates, mutation receipts, schema validation records, export manifests, audit events) continue functioning when product telemetry is disabled and when remote telemetry contribution is disabled. Enterprise audit/evidence is mandatory substrate, not optional tracking.
pack_artifacts.content_light_constraints: Guarantee statements and verification status. No evidence payloads.

procurement_facing_summary.format: Single-page HTML + PDF with executive summary, key metrics, and links to detailed artifacts.
sections: Known Limitations and Open Risks (1 page)

static_docs_integration.navigation: Added to static site navigation under 'Enterprise' or 'Trust Center'
static_docs_integration.render_pipeline: Integrated into existing static site renderer (scripts/rig_site_render.py)

content_light_constraints_global: No raw prompts, completions, or model outputs
No raw source code or file contents
No secrets, API keys, tokens, or credentials
No absolute file paths from user machines
No debug data or stack traces
SHA256 hashes for all content-derived references
